about: The meter's known coverage gaps (METER-2a, R-165.272): pieces BUILT stages already used when tools/difficulty/coveragecheck.ts started, with no bot or no channel. Shrink-only (knowncheck.mjs LISTS; coveragecheck fails an entry that is covered or no longer used). A piece here keeps its pre-gate price in score.ts (marked in the challenge note); any other unpriced piece is refused.

known.owner: METER-2b (the meter: a mushroom launch priced as a bouncy move, moveOf's bounce rows)
known.why: route.ts makes a launch off a cap a 'bounce' move and jumps.ts routeJumps takes jumps and hops only, so it scored 0 bits

known.owner: METER-2b (the meter: a long jump / leaf glide priced as a move with its reach)
known.why: route.ts calls a linked gap no jump covers a 'glide'; routeJumps skips it, so it scored 0 bits

known.owner: METER-2b (the meter: a hop the level check cannot confirm priced as the jump it flies, or the route made to confirm it)
known.why: a route link the level check cannot confirm; routeJumps skips it, so it scored 0 bits

known.owner: METER-2b step 3 (dwell channel, [2-2]) and step 5 (the clock SKILL's dwell half)
known.why: a 'Z' beat with no channel: score.ts priced it a flat 2 bits; the bot has no crumble behaviour (it never leaves before 'gone')

known.owner: METER-2b step 5 (the clock SKILL's dwell half)
known.why: the bot treats crumbling wood as ground: it never leaves before it goes
